criteria.text: Keeping "PATH2" while changing its assertion from an empty error stream to a PATH warning shows 1 → 1 tests and the exact old → new line.
Removing one assertion in a kept case shows its old line → (removed); assertions in a wholly removed case appear only as a named test removal.
An unchanged assertion produces no changed-assertion entry, and a newly added assertion shows (added) → its exact line.
